questions.question: Which feature of PowerPoint is useful for importing a set of pictures into a presentation?
questions.explanation: The chapter states that the Photo Album feature is useful for importing a set of pictures into a presentation.

questions.question: By default, how many pictures appear on each slide when using the Photo Album feature?
questions.explanation: The chapter says that by default only one picture appears on each slide.

questions.question: Which tab contains the New Photo Album option described in the chapter?
questions.explanation: The steps instruct the user to go to the Insert tab and select New Photo Album from the Photo Album drop-down menu.

questions.question: In the Photo Album dialog box, which tab is selected to pick pictures from the computer?
questions.explanation: The chapter instructs the user to choose the File/Disk tab under the Insert pictures from section.

questions.question: After pictures are selected in the Photo Album dialog box, where are they listed so that their order can be changed?
questions.explanation: The selected pictures are added under the Pictures in album box, where their order can be rearranged using the up and down arrows.
